# Jarwis
> Multi-agent AI platform: one commander (Commander-00) coordinating 99+ specialised assistants with human approval for risky actions.

- [Assistants](https://jarwis.ai/assistants/): six clusters of assistants
- [Architecture](https://jarwis.ai/architecture/): how missions flow
